removeBody: Aldwin stops using its tools and forgets its sign-in. You can add it again later.
urlHint: You'll find it in the app's help pages. It looks like https://mcp.example.com/mcp.
badUrl: Enter a full address that starts with https:// or http://.
none: No apps connected yet. Pick one below to connect it.
toolsHint: Each app gives Aldwin tools, small actions like reading an issue or creating a page.
libraryHint: Pick an app to connect it. Some will ask you to sign in.
useHint: Turn off to stop Aldwin using {title} without removing it.
addLede: For an app that isn't in the list. Paste its MCP server address and Aldwin will connect to it.
noMatch: No app matches "{query}". If it has an MCP server, use Add a custom app.
connecting: Checking the server and listing its tools…
connectedTools: Aldwin can now use its {count} tools.
connectedOneTool: Aldwin can now use its 1 tool.
connectedBody: Aldwin can now use its tools.
